context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: かもめ/持ち歩く/炊飯/日替わり/湿っ/ミニチュア/玉子/アテ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、海に行ったとき、絶対、かもめ、絶対、たくさん、絶対、いたわね
lines.en: Remember when we went to the beach, Sho? There were so many seagulls.
lines.style: Warm, reminiscing tone. Gentle lift on the memory. Slow, comfortable pace—speaking as much to herself as to him. Maternal ease.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お弁当箱、絶対、持ち歩く、絶対、ようにしてるよ
lines.en: Mom, that's why I always keep my lunch box with me now.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact pride. Steady voice. Small but genuine—like he's solved a problem that matters to him. No bragging, just fact-stating.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今晩の、本気で、絶対、炊飯、絶対、ママ、絶対、もう少しで、絶対、終わるからね、翔くん
lines.en: The rice should be ready soon, sweetheart. Just a little longer.
lines.style: Soft, reassuring tone. Voice settling at the end like a promise. Slight warmth on 'soon'—letting him know he doesn't have to wait much longer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、給食、絶対、日替わり、絶対、メニュー、絶対、楽しみだよ
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to what they serve for school lunch tomorrow.
lines.style: Bright, anticipatory energy. The lift of genuine interest—he's not performing, he really means it. Light pace, open syllables.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 梅雨で、本気で、絶対、お布団が、絶対、湿って、絶対、しまうわね、翔くん
lines.en: With the rainy season here, the futon gets so damp, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tired observation. Not complaining—just noticing. Gentle exhale quality. Speaking more to the reality of the season than to him directly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんから、絶対、ミニチュア、絶対、の車、絶対、もらったよ、ママ
lines.en: Grandpa gave me a little toy car, Mom!
lines.style: Quick, bright excitement. Energy on 'gave'—the joy is fresh. Voice open and unselfconscious. The genuine bounce of a child sharing something that made him happy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日の朝食、本気で、絶対、玉子、絶対、焼きにしようね、翔くん
lines.en: Tomorrow for breakfast, let's make tamagoyaki, okay Sho?
lines.style: Warm, gentle suggestion. Light, planning tone—not commanding. The softness of offering him something he likes. Slight rise at the end like a shared decision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お酒の、絶対、アテ、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、何を作るの?本気で
lines.en: Mom, what's Dad going to ask you to make as a snack with his drinks?
lines.style: Curious, direct question. Perceptive—he's noticing the pattern adults often miss. Small voice, genuine wondering. Not accusatory, just observant.
